mobbin:bd125cb4-4946-44ee-a252-1e51eddab.summary: From the Square home/setup dashboard the user opens Create item, picks an item type, fills a dense POS form (internal vs customer-facing name, price, online sale price, AI description, locations/channels), saves, and lands on Item library with a created toast.
steal: Item-type chooser first so later fields match the kind of thing (step 2) — map to Equipment vs Consumable vs Service.
Internal name vs customer-facing name on one form (steps 4–5).
Sidebar Status / Categories / Locations alongside the main form (steps 3–11).
List status pill with quantity (e.g. "20 available") plus created toast (step 12).
avoid: Kitchen name, menus, sales channels, taxes, nutritional accordion, dual retail/online prices — retail POS chrome that fights a light sim-center catalog.
mobbin:bd125cb4-4946-44ee-a252-1e51eddab.fit: Clash / counter-example for Essentials' light inventory: replace with a short type → name/unit/location/photo create; keep type-first and location sidebar ideas only.

mobbin:addf5027-28db-4b51-a6f7-24577166a.summary: From an empty Item library the user uploads a CSV, waits through import progress, reviews/edits a grid, chooses add-and-update vs overwrite, hits an all-failed error modal with downloadable report, then sees Import Successful and the updated library.
steal: Empty state dual path: Create an item + Import items + Download template (step 1).
Editable review grid before commit, with row delete (steps 5–6).
Explicit merge decision: Add and update existing vs Delete and overwrite (step 7).
Failure modal: Require review vs Imported successfully counts + Download error report / Upload fixed errors (step 9).
avoid: Blocking full-page import that warns "don't leave this page" (step 4) when a later step already allows closing and continuing elsewhere (step 8).
mobbin:addf5027-28db-4b51-a6f7-24577166a.fit: Extends Essentials item onboarding for centers migrating catalogs; merge vs overwrite and error-report loop are especially useful where failure cases are still undefined.

mobbin:981b5fb6-e739-4767-ac84-ddb20d085.summary: From Item library row actions the user opens Update low stock alert, sets alert amount and location, updates, and gets a success toast without leaving the list.
steps: Row menu Update low stock alert
steal: Low-stock config reachable from list row overflow without opening full edit (step 1).
Copy that names both surfaces: marked low stock in library + daily low stock alert email (steps 2–3).
Stay-on-list success toast after threshold save (step 4).
mobbin:981b5fb6-e739-4767-ac84-ddb20d085.fit: Extends the planned reorder/trend notifications: per-item threshold + location + digest email maps cleanly; skip retail-only list chrome.
